why: Phase C fix B (#2304, prod 2026-10-13 Hard Fork 'Sora and the Infinite Slop Feeds'): two stated hosts, one live host voice, and nothing in its own words naming it. With the feed-stated hosts kept in the pool (fix A) both names are spare and one-name-one-seat cannot choose. The seat keeps ADDRESSING Kevin ('Well, Kevin, ...', 20 to 5 on prod), so it is Casey Newton. Before fix A this seat got Casey only because the intro clip's 'I'm Kevin Roose' had thrown Kevin out of the pool.
